answer: Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Each submission hangs on the river of a task receipt, and the mesa is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, released only after three unrelated confirmations, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Reaching the quartz of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
